objective: RRR GATE 4D-R2: crear V2 del script Customer360 corrigiendo unicamente batching de CREATE VIEW para SQL Server y ejecutar en no-Production. Mantener contrato logico V1. Preflight inmediato, ejecucion controlada y post-audit de presencia/cardinalidad. Cero DML. Produccion prohibida.

actions.content:
/* RRR GATE 4 CUSTOMER360 VIEWS V2 - SQL SERVER BATCH SAFE */

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial AS
SELECT
    v.ClienteID,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS VentasCount,
    MIN(v.FechaVenta) AS FechaPrimeraVenta,
    MAX(v.FechaVenta) AS FechaUltimaVenta,
    SUM(v.Total) AS VentasTotal
FROM dbo.Venta_Encabezado v
GROUP BY v.ClienteID;
GO

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual AS
SELECT ClienteID, ScoreID, ModeloVersion, Score, CalculadoAtUtc, FechaOperacionCorte
FROM (
    SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.ClienteID ORDER BY s.CalculadoAtUtc DESC, s.ScoreID DESC) AS rn
    FROM dbo.RRR_ScoreHistorial s
) x
WHERE rn = 1;
GO

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual AS
SELECT ClienteID, RankingID, ScoreID, ModeloVersion, RankCode, CalculadoAtUtc, VigenteDesde, VigenteHasta
FROM (
    SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.ClienteID ORDER BY r.CalculadoAtUtc DESC, r.RankingID DESC) AS rn
    FROM dbo.RRR_RankingHistorial r
) x
WHERE rn = 1;
GO

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_RRR_Customer360 AS
SELECT
    c.ClienteID,
    c.CodigoCliente,
    c.RazonSocial,
    c.NombreComercial,
    c.EmailPrincipal,
    c.TelefonoPrincipal,
    c.SectorID,
    c.TamanoClienteID,
    c.RiesgoCuentaID,
    c.EsProspecto,
    c.EsPartner,
    c.EsCuentaEstrategica,
    c.FechaUltimaInteraccion,
    a.FechaPrimeraVenta,
    a.FechaUltimaVenta,
    COALESCE(a.VentasCount,0) AS VentasCount,
    COALESCE(a.VentasTotal,0) AS VentasTotal,
    s.Score AS ScoreRRR,
    s.ModeloVersion AS ScoreModeloVersion,
    s.CalculadoAtUtc AS ScoreCalculadoAtUtc,
    r.RankCode,
    r.ModeloVersion AS RankModeloVersion,
    r.CalculadoAtUtc AS RankCalculadoAtUtc
FROM dbo.Cliente_Catalogo c
LEFT JOIN dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial a ON a.ClienteID=c.ClienteID
LEFT JOIN dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual s ON s.ClienteID=c.ClienteID
LEFT JOIN dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual r ON r.ClienteID=c.ClienteID;
GO

name: RRR Gate 4 Customer360 V2 Development

on:
  push:
    branches: [Edarsahub_Desarrollo]
    paths: [ops/migrations/requests/RRR-GATE4-CUSTOMER360-V2-20260909.execute]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: rrr-gate4-customer360-v2-development
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  migrate-development:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: development
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST: '54.39.104.176'
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT: '1433'
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE: 'EDARSAHUB'
      MIGRATION_SCRIPT: docs/RRR/sql/RRR_GATE4_CUSTOMER360_VIEWS_V2.sql
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {ref: '${{ github.sha }}'}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: '3.11'}
      - name: Install SQL runtime
        run: python -m pip install pymssql
      - name: Preflight absence and permissions
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import os,pymssql
          views=['vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial','vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual','vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual','vw_RRR_Customer360']
          c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD']);q=c.cursor(as_dict=True);p=','.join(['%s']*4);q.execute(f"SELECT name FROM sys.objects WHERE schema_id=SCHEMA_ID('dbo') AND name IN ({p})",tuple(views));existing=q.fetchall();q.execute("SELECT HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(DB_NAME(),'DATABASE','CREATE VIEW') cv,HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo','SCHEMA','ALTER') ad");perms=q.fetchone();q.close();c.close();print(existing,perms);assert not existing;assert int(perms['cv'])==1 and int(perms['ad'])==1
          PY
      - name: Execute GO batches transactionally
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import os,re,pymssql,pathlib
          sql=pathlib.Path(os.environ['MIGRATION_SCRIPT']).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          batches=[b.strip() for b in re.split(r'(?im)^\s*GO\s*$',sql) if b.strip()]
          if len(batches)!=4: raise SystemExit(f'EXPECTED_4_BATCHES_GOT_{len(batches)}')
          c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD'],autocommit=False)
          q=c.cursor()
          try:
              for b in batches: q.execute(b)
              c.commit()
          except Exception:
              c.rollback(); raise
          finally:
              q.close(); c.close()
          print('EXECUTED_4_CREATE_VIEW_BATCHES')
          PY
      - name: Postcheck
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import os,pymssql,json
          views=['vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial','vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual','vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual','vw_RRR_Customer360']
          c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD']);q=c.cursor(as_dict=True);p=','.join(['%s']*4);q.execute(f"SELECT name FROM sys.views WHERE schema_id=SCHEMA_ID('dbo') AND name IN ({p}) ORDER BY name",tuple(views));got=[r['name'] for r in q.fetchall()];q.execute('SELECT ClienteID,COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM dbo.vw_RRR_Customer360 GROUP BY ClienteID HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1');dups=q.fetchall();q.execute('SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM dbo.vw_RRR_Customer360');n360=int(q.fetchone()['n']);q.execute('SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM dbo.Cliente_Catalogo');nc=int(q.fetchone()['n']);q.close();c.close();print(json.dumps({'views':got,'duplicates':dups,'customer360_rows':n360,'cliente_catalogo_rows':nc,'production_touched':False},default=str));assert set(got)==set(views);assert not dups;assert n360==nc
          PY
